meta.title: A live RFQ: "0 / 1 0%" opens the "Participation Summary 1 Invited 0 Seen 0 Bid Placed 1 Bid Not Placed 0 Unregistered Poc Bids" window
gaps: The exact behavior of clicking the Responses participation indicator "0 / 1 0%" to open the window.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact behavior of clicking the Responses participation indicator "0 / 1 0%" to open the window.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on its Responses tab, as required for prepared-state cases.
Open the RFQ's Participation Summary drawer, which is the catalog path for this window.
Assert that the participation summary window is open.
Verify the invited count shown in the summary.
Verify that no invited vendor has been seen.
Verify the bid-placed count shown in the summary.
Verify the bid-not-placed count shown in the summary.
Verify the unregistered POC bid count shown in the summary.
Verify that the Notify action is present without pressing it.
